description: 17 consensus null positions use only 7 distinct letters {B,G,I,K,O,W,Z}

rival_critiques.frequentist: Positional null is mismatched to SA discovery process. IC-greedy proxy shows 0/10K shuffled at <=7 distinct (mean 10.78), suggesting 7 IS anomalous under score-conditioned null.
rival_critiques.bayesian: Model-dependent (Jaccard 0.161). Prior for stego is low. Posterior odds <1:1.
rival_critiques.optimization_forensics: 0/40K SA masks achieve <=7. But SA covers vanishing fraction of C(73,17). Not a proper null.
rival_critiques.null_model_engineer: Correct null is score-conditioned positional. Never constructed. IC-greedy is a weak proxy.
rival_critiques.heretic: If cipher model is wrong, positions are meaningless and palette is coincidence.

effect_size: observed 7 distinct vs expected 12.84 (5.84 below mean)
robustness: 0/40K SA, 0/10K IC-greedy, 0/500 shuffled-CT SA all fail to reproduce
discriminating_power: none — does not point to specific cipher
action: KEEP but construct score-conditioned null before further investment

description: BCL Beaufort keystream 7/8 palette letters at positions 63-70
null_model: binomial: P(palette)=7/26 at each of 8 positions

rival_critiques.frequentist: Cherry-picked window (first 8 of 11). Corrected for 4 windows: p=2.5e-3. Still fails global correction.
rival_critiques.bayesian: DEPENDENT on A1 palette definition. Not an independent test.
rival_critiques.optimization_forensics: Not optimizer-derived; computed directly from CT and cribs.
rival_critiques.null_model_engineer: P(random 7-palette gets >=7/8 BCL) = 0.64%. Higher baseline than claimed.
rival_critiques.heretic: Beaufort-specific. If K4 is not Beaufort, claim is void.

discriminating_power: weak — supports Beaufort but does not survive correction
action: RETIRE as independent signal. Note as dependent observation under A1.

description: Keystream AP {6,10,14} has 12/24 hits under Beaufort
null_model: specific AP: binomial. Corrected: max over 312 APs via MC.

rival_critiques.frequentist: Uncorrected p inflated 230x by ignoring search over 312 APs.
rival_critiques.null_model_engineer: Expected max-AP-hits for random 24-sequence: 7.44. Observed 12 is ~3sigma before look-elsewhere but noise after.

description: Beaufort keystream unlike English (chi-sq p=4e-6 vs English)
null_model: chi-square vs English letter frequencies, df=25, n=24

rival_critiques.frequentist: Survives Bonferroni at face value. But the original claim P(Z>=2 AND K>=3)=1.1e-7 is cherry-picked.
rival_critiques.bayesian: Uninformative: keystream SHOULD differ from English under most cipher models.
rival_critiques.null_model_engineer: Chi-sq vs UNIFORM: p=0.0048. Keystream only modestly concentrated.
rival_critiques.heretic: With n=24 and df=25, chi-square has negligible power. Any short cipher output will fail English chi-sq.

discriminating_power: none — expected for any cipher output
action: DEMOTE. Note as 'keystream differs from English' but this is expected, not diagnostic.
